### English source — DO NOT EDIT

<!-- SOURCE_TURN_001_BEGIN -->
Growing a YouTube channel takes time, effort, and consistency. Here are some steps you can follow to help you reach your goal:

1. Define your niche: Focus on a specific area of beauty that you're passionate about and knowledgeable in.
2. Create quality content: Invest in high-quality equipment and put effort into filming and editing your videos.
3. Optimize your videos: Use keywords in your title, description, and tags to help your videos rank higher in search results.
4. Promote your channel: Share your videos on social media, collaborate with other YouTubers, and engage with your audience to build a community.
5. Be consistent: Upload videos regularly to keep your audience engaged and coming back for more.
6. Utilize paid promotion: Consider using social media ads or YouTube's paid promotion options to reach a wider audience.

Remember, growing a YouTube channel takes time and effort, so be patient and persistent. Good luck!

### English source — DO NOT EDIT

<!-- SOURCE_TURN_003_BEGIN -->
Achieving 40,000 watch hours on a new beauty YouTube channel will require consistent and high-quality content, audience engagement, and a well-executed promotion strategy. Here are some steps to help you reach this goal:

1. Consistently upload high-quality videos: Focus on providing valuable content that your audience will want to watch and engage with.
2. Engage with your audience: Respond to comments and ask for feedback to build a strong community and keep your viewers engaged.
3. Optimize your videos for discoverability: Use keywords in your titles, descriptions, and tags to make your videos more easily discoverable by potential viewers.
4. Promote your channel: Share your videos on social media, collaborate with other YouTubers, and participate in YouTube's community features, such as comments and live streams.
5. Utilize paid promotion: Consider using social media ads or YouTube's paid promotion options to reach a wider audience.
6. Analyze your performance: Use YouTube analytics to track your performance and adjust your strategy as needed to ensure you are reaching your target audience and maximizing your watch time.

It takes time and effort to grow a YouTube channel, so be patient, persistent, and keep experimenting with new strategies until you reach your goal. Good luck!
<!-- SOURCE_TURN_003_END -->

### English source — DO NOT EDIT

<!-- SOURCE_TURN_005_BEGIN -->
Monetizing a YouTube channel takes time and effort, but with a well-executed plan, you can start earning revenue in three months. Here are some steps you can follow:

1. Build your audience: Focus on creating high-quality content and promoting your channel to build an engaged community.
2. Meet YouTube's monetization requirements: To monetize your channel, you must meet YouTube's Partner Program requirements, which include having at least 1,000 subscribers and 4,000 watch hours in the past 12 months.
3. Enable monetization: Once you've met YouTube's requirements, you can enable monetization on your channel through the YouTube Studio.
4. Apply for Google AdSense: You'll need to apply for a Google AdSense account to receive payment for your YouTube earnings.
5. Use affiliate marketing: Consider partnering with brands and promoting their products in your videos. You can earn a commission on any sales made through your unique affiliate link.
6. Offer sponsored content: As your channel grows, you may have the opportunity to work with brands to create sponsored content.
7. Diversify your revenue streams: Consider offering additional products or services, such as digital products, courses, or merchandise, to increase your earning potential.

Remember, monetizing a YouTube channel takes time and effort, so be persistent and keep experimenting with new strategies to find what works best for you. Good luck!
<!-- SOURCE_TURN_005_END -->
